remarks.p: Covers every row of the field collapse matrix: a default "content" key, an explicit json-value-key, a boolean flag, and multi-item markup content. The OSCAL fixtures contain no json-value-key and no boolean flags, so the matrix cannot be made total from them.

define-assembly.name: holder
define-assembly.description: Carries one of each field shape.

define-field.name: plain-text
define-field.description: No flags and no value key, so its JSON key is "content".

define-field.name: keyed-value
define-field.description: Carries an explicit json-value-key, so its JSON key is not "content".

define-field.name: flagged-text
define-field.description: Has a boolean flag, so a set flag keeps object form.

define-flag.name: active
define-flag.description: A boolean flag, including when set to false.

define-field.name: content
define-field.description: Gives the holder assembly a :content attribute, so "has a content attribute" cannot be used to tell an assembly from a field.
